name: Chunkies Coconut Cookies
ingredients: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, COCONUT PRODUCTS (16.5%) [DESICCATED COCONUT & COCONUT MILK POWDER] INTERESTERIFIED VEGETABLE FAT, BUTTER, INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, RAISING AGENTS [503, 500(ii)& 450(i)], NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, EMULSIFIERS [322(i), 471 & 472e) AND IODIZED SALT.
